'''IR-77''' was an advanced [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] deployed by the intergalactic [[Spy/Legends|spymaster]] known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] to protect his interests across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[3638 BBY]], IR-77 was repeatedly deployed on numerous worlds to attack an enemy of the Shroud who was investigating the Shroud's relay network, but the droid was destroyed after trying to thwart an attempt on the life of [[Maki'voro]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
